provenance.tuned_on: Attain SMP WS_V2.0, all 847 images (refit after grouped 5-fold CV)
provenance.eligibility: probe decides a class only if its pooled out-of-fold AUROC 95% lower bound > 0.5
provenance.note: thresholds are tuned on vehicle-mounted Attain frames; not yet validated against labelled Bengaluru photos

stage1_safety_net.meaning: Stage 1 said Normal but some headline type has P(yes) >= threshold: route to expert review instead of auto-classifying Normal

oof.note: flagged = would be sent to expert review instead of auto-classified Normal

views.note: Decisions use the full photograph. Per-tile scores are RECORDED on every upload so scripts/calibrate_probe_from_expert_labels.py can compare full vs tiled on expert-labelled Bengaluru photos. On Attain, tiles raised cross-validated macro MCC 0.248 -> 0.308 (p = 0.047) but not test AUROC significantly, and cost ~6.5 s per upload (eval_results/stage2_views_report.json, paper 6.9). Remove 'record' to save that time.
